blurb: Welcome to the Monticello Railway Museum, a non-profit, all-volunteer organization in central Illinois with an operational railroad and yard open to the public. For the 2026 season, we will be offering train rides on Saturdays and Sundays from May 2 through October 4, as well as a number of special events throughout the year.
